name: Stone Warehouse
description: Three-storey stone warehouse with tall open floors on oak posts, cart doors, crates, sacks and shelving. Two enclosed stair cores at opposite ends; the open floors give long interior sightlines. B2: a dressed cart arch over the double doors, pilaster strips between the bays, string courses, chamfered plinth, a stepped cornice, a loading dormer with its hoist beam, ivy on the west gable.
